Hello all,


I have two questions related to multi group testing. I read the page on the tutorial site and understand that I need to test for model invariance
I noticed the three invariance types (configural, weak, and strong) and putting these into:
lavTestLRT(invar_fit1, invar_fit2, invar_fit3)

I also acknowledge that
measurementInvariance(model = semModel_IM, data = data, estimator = "mlr", group = "gender", method = "satorra.bentler.2010")
is deprecated.

a) How can one test whether certain path coefficients are significantly different?
b) What happens in cases when invariance cannot be established?

These seem like basic questions. Maybe there is some example or lecture or similar introductory.


Thanks for your comments.

Carsten
